jei.mortal_integrations.secret_hint: The dead guard this knowledge. Learn this recipe through Secrets of the Dead in the Book of Ectcetera. Viewing it here does not teach it.
jei.mortal_integrations.charge_fuel: Charge fuel: 4 Raw Ectoplasm or 1 Purified Ectoplasm per operation. FE is an alternative.
jei.mortal_integrations.bucket_return: Water is consumed; the bucket is returned.
jei.mortal_integrations.cauldron_heat: Full cauldron with a heat source below. Add one reagent.
jei.mortal_integrations.cauldron_buckets: Buckets depict fluids. Collect the result with an empty bucket; containers are reused.
jei.mortal_integrations.book_info: Craft a Book with Rotten Flesh. Upgrade in order with Bone, Raw Ectoplasm, then solid Purified Ectoplasm. Secret recipes still need Spectral Insight revelations, even when visible in JEI.
jei.mortal_integrations.generator_info: Burns raw or purified ectoplasm to produce FE. Completed burns add 1 or 3 chunk Haunt respectively. Output depends on chunk Haunt.
jei.mortal_integrations.furnace_info: Smelts normal furnace recipes. Needs starting fuel; preserves remaining burn time at Demonic chunk Haunt or higher. Below Demonic, burn time falls only while cooking advances.
